text:
Lihn still bleeds too much to speak
of Lihn gone Lihn, “defunctus
adhuc loquitur”; preferable
the absent body of his figure; the burial
does not matter, nor the parable
of the burial's decay: something
that only he and I,
each
in his U-Bahn beneath another
unreal Spree,
each coffin
in its bark,
each nobody
in his nobody, unlubricated
as I go amid the screech
of Berlin's gulls with no
beyond or
this side except in the south
toward the west Adriana,
most sorrowful, Andrea
beneath the drizzle, which
confirms
it all:

Now Lihn
has the floor;
wall
and wall.

translation.title: Lihn Still Bleeds Too Much to Speak...
